Pantoprazole delayed-release tablets are a finished dosage form for retail sale, so they fall in heading 3004 (medicaments in measured doses). Pantoprazole is a benzimidazole derivative, which has a pyrimidine-like ring structure, but the nearest specific HTS provision is 3004.90.92.

Pantoprazole is 5-(difluoromethoxy)-2-[[(3,4-dimethoxy-2-pyridinyl)methyl]sulfinyl]-1H-benzimidazole. Its structure is a benzimidazole with a pyridine ring, so it is not a pyrimidine.

CBP rulings classify pantoprazole tablets under 3004.90.9255 or 3004.90.9290. The 3004.90.92 subheading covers "Other: Other: Other", and its statistical suffixes include 3004.90.9210 for those with a specific listing. I recall that 3004.90.9255 is "Other" and 3004.90.9250 is "Drugs for gastrointestinal..."; I am not certain of the exact suffix, so the 9255 code is my best recollection. A ruling for pantoprazole delayed-release tablets cites 3004.90.9255, which I take to be the more likely match.
